title: The US sanctions Russia-backed payment network A7, freezing any of its US assets, and accuses it of helping Iran and its proxy groups to evade Western sanctions (Amy Mackinnon/Financial Times)
summary: Amy Mackinnon / Financial Times: The US sanctions Russia-backed payment network A7, freezing any of its US assets, and accuses it of helping Iran and its proxy groups to evade Western sanctions — Payments group that moved almost $7bn through global banks designated a transnational criminal organisation
